name: owned-api-declarations
goal: Package declarations for owner-local cross-workspace SDK functions without changing public import paths

evidence: Owner-local placement puts three Web-compatible public SDK modules under Reports. The build still fixes TypeScript rootDir to src, so API declaration generation fails TS6059. Preserve placement and public SDK addresses while emitting the complete transitive declaration tree.

General typecheck admits workspace sources; the declaration boundary was only checked late in a full build. Extend packaged API coverage with a focused declaration-only build that asserts configured public type entry paths exist, plus typed console imports in the empty consumer.

Test-only 30c0e35a fails the actual public declaration build in an isolated source fixture. Immutable red ef3d9e4c15822784fa815fbc053d05f5708ff1cb21dbad0fa0782a20952d9095 records TS6059 and the public API build assertion; live source and regression snapshot inputs remain unchanged.

Emit declarations using the repository as the source root, retaining transitive owner-local files under dist/types. Generate forwarding declaration entries at the existing public dist/types/lib paths. Add a declaration-only mode to the existing builder so the packaged API guard can run early and independently.

The existing API builder emits the complete transitive declaration tree under dist/types and writes stable public type forwarders. Its types-only mode uses the same builder without application or kernel work. The standard packaged API test checks public entry files and a strict typed console consumer.
